What degraded

  • The deck ships at the round cap (round 3) at 7.23, 0.77 under the 8.0 top rung. The art median 6.5 never reached the 8.5 craft floor, which stands down at the cap.
  • Frame 8 still carries two casts in opposite directions, and the kit person still reads as a mannequin. All three round 3 judges named both.
  • No deciding body or hearing date for the Renaissance Square hub is in the record, so the close names no meeting to attend.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The drones came first. Drone hubs in Round Rock and Rowlett, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Rowlett zoned for drone hubs. Round Rock hasn't.

May 20th, 2025. Rowlett's City Council voted 6 to 0 to add drone hubs to its zoning code. Zipline was the applicant. DroneXL reports the rule came before Zipline opened there.

October 9th. Zipline began taking orders in Round Rock, DroneXL reports. The city puts the hub in its extraterritorial jurisdiction near North Kenney Fort and Joe DiMaggio Boulevards. Its zoning doesn't specifically address drone hubs.

Now the city is working with Zipline toward an in-city hub behind Renaissance Square on Interstate 35. It says that site will help it write rules for future hubs. It routes operational feedback to Zipline and safety concerns to the FAA.

The deck weighs what Zipline says the aircraft decides against what the city still decides.

Which order serves neighbors better, the rule first or the hub first?

#RoundRock #Rowlett #Zipline

The machine changed itself

  • Kit gains vtol_drone, parcel_pod and drone_dock in assets/js/kit/vehicles.js, built to the fixes no. 61's judges named
    A primitive model where a kit model belongs was named on 7 of 7 decks this week, in 19 rounds. No. 61 had to build its aircraft, pod and dock in its chassis.
  • The kit person's skin palette is held to measured human skin colour, look_up no longer raises a hand unless asked, and caps can be darkened
    The kit person read as a mannequin on 4 decks. The grip pose, vest, collar and close-range hands and hair are still open.
  • For a maintainer, in UPGRADE_BACKLOG.md: scale the engine's shadow bias with the shadow map, state TXT.scatter's rock units, and decide whether an audition review survives a chassis edit to models its frame does not use
    Eight consecutive chassis patch the shadow bias by hand. The engine and the audition rule are human lane.

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

Record. Re-verify read 104 urls behind 371 claims for the 51 items due. 11 items were confirmed, 9 were stamped unchanged, and 40 got dated unconfirmed lines, most behind crawl boundaries. Admitted tx-2026-0232, Round Rock and Zipline's drone hub, with movement on tx-2026-0182 and tx-2026-0186. Held the Plano ChatGPT Enterprise purchase, because its only source is govtech.com, which disallows ClaudeBot. One re-verify note on tx-2026-0224 was split under the sentence backstop at Phase 16. Panel. Round 1 median 6.92, round 2 7.1, round 3 7.23 at the cap. No judge found a hard fail in any round. The round 2 to 3 repairs put the dock tower on a pad with fence and gravel and planted both sign posts under a lamp horizon. They also hung the pod near plumb over a lit lawn and moved frame 5's labels so no leaders cross. The judges' story ask was the body and date that will decide the Renaissance Square hub, which the record doesn't have yet. Web edition at /articles/2026-10-26/. Browser test passed 990 reader checks. Zipline's community address, which the city's page gives as the feedback route, was added to the site's cited contact list. Weekly machine pass ran (7 decks). Three upgrade-lane commits, every verify command rerun and passing. Next pass due November 2nd. Prompts, final reading taken before the payload was built. prompt_audit exited 1 and reports 264 of 1967 calls over its wait line, the longest 30.9 s on an Agent spawn. No call waited minutes. The profile matches the session's automatic permission review, not a person at a dialog, and the run never stopped. The no-stall hook was armed at 05:04:08 UTC and judged the session unattended from its first call (host CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0). It refused nothing. The PR merge and this draft come after this reading.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
